propositions: A class with a fallback list must build a pydantic-ai FallbackModel wrapper whose default is the primary entry and whose fallback entries are selected on provider/rate-limit/availability errors.

The fallback_on predicate must be derived from failure._RETRYABLE union CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL to ensure automatic drift correction on taxonomy changes, and must exclude CHANGE_SETTINGS and CHANGE_INPUT to preserve loud failure on credential and input-size errors.

Fallback entries carrying endpoint must be resolved to models built against that endpoint, not the provider default, and all sub-model clients must be registered on the same ProviderSession and closed exactly once.

Capabilities must be computed from the intersection of all candidate models before FallbackModel wrapping to prevent silent capability regression when a fallback model lacks a feature the primary has.
The ran_model field in provider_provenance must be read from ModelResponse.model_name (the actual answering model) not from FallbackModel.model_name (the synthetic fallback: string).

A plain 429 rate-limit error must trigger fallback, but a 429 carrying insufficient_quota must not, as quota exhaustion is a spend problem that should fail loudly rather than shopping silently across providers.
